mentions.name: Boot.dev
mentions.description: Boot.dev is an online platform for learning software development through interactive courses. The team is keeping the platform running and expanding its catalog with an in-browser update to the Kubernetes (k8s) course, plus new C, Terraform, and bash courses in the pipeline.
mentions.problem: Sustaining a coding-education platform amid a wave of 'AI doomerism' questioning the value of being good at things like programming.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Just trying to keep https://www.boot.dev alive and kicking amidst this wave of AI doomerism surrounding... The value of being good at things.

Working on an in-browser update of our k8s course, a new C course, as well as terraform and bash courses coming down the pipe.
mentions.author: wagslane
